cases.name: Anissa Sells Osbourne
cases.about: She was an RV life blogger. “She was very, very happy, just a very kind of free spirit,” her cousin, Laura Lorenzo Curry, said in an interview. “She was a really vibrant, bubbly personality, absolutely hilarious.” Anissa had previously worked as a nurse before moving to the campground with her husband, whom she married more than 15 years ago.
cases.narrative: On 5/3/2026, they were found deceased at Ocean Pond Campground in the Osceola National Forest in FL.
